story-context.summary: Implement status message handling in Telegram bot to show real-time updates during request processing. On receiving a user message, immediately send a status message ("🔄 Annie is thinking..."), then update it in-place as status frames arrive from the SSE stream. When the first token arrives, transition seamlessly to streaming the actual response in the same message. Handle pending messages when user sends multiple messages while processing.

criterion.description: Initial Status Message: Send "🔄 Annie is thinking..." immediately (<100ms) on message receipt and store message_id for edits
criterion.target-latency: 100ms from message receipt to status message sent

criterion.description: Status Message Editing: Each status frame from SSE triggers edit_message_text() using stored message_id, reusing existing rate limit handling
Transition to Response: On first token frame, clear status message content and begin streaming actual response in the same message
criterion.requirement: Seamless visual transition, no flicker or duplicate messages

criterion.description: Pending Message Indicator: When user sends message while processing, show "📝 Got it - will handle after current request..." and track count
criterion.multiple-pending: Update to "📝 Added to pending (N follow-up messages)..." for subsequent messages

modification.description: Update stream_response_to_telegram() to handle status frames and use stored message_id
modification.location: Update function signature and add status frame handling
modification.code-pattern:
async def stream_response_to_telegram( backend_client, conversation_id: str, user_id: int, message: TelegramMessage, typing_task: asyncio.Task, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE, # NEW: for bot.edit_message_text() state: dict # NEW: for status_message_id ): """ Stream LLM response to Telegram with status updates and message editing.
Handles status frames from SSE stream by editing the status message. When first token arrives, transitions to streaming response in same message. """ response_buffer = [] sent_messages = [] chunk_count = 0 last_update_time = 0 rate_limit_until = 0 is_first_token = True
# Get status_message_id from state (AC #1) status_message_id = state.get("status_message_id") chat_id = message.chat_id
# Get the stream generator stream = backend_client.stream_response(conversation_id, user_id) first_token_timeout = backend_client.first_token_timeout
try: async for chunk_data in stream: # Parse chunk as JSON to detect type if isinstance(chunk_data, str): # Handle raw text chunks (backward compatibility) content = chunk_data chunk_type = "token" else: # Handle structured SSE frames chunk_type = chunk_data.get("type") content = chunk_data.get("content") or chunk_data.get("message", "")
# Handle status frames (AC #2) if chunk_type == "status" and status_message_id: current_time_ms = time.time() * 1000 time_since_last_update = current_time_ms - last_update_time is_rate_limited = current_time_ms < rate_limit_until
# Apply debouncing (reuse MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS) if time_since_last_update >= MIN_UPDATE_INTERVAL_MS and not is_rate_limited: try: await context.bot.edit_message_text( chat_id=chat_id, message_id=status_message_id, text=content ) last_update_time = current_time_ms
logger.debug( "Status message updated", extra={ "user_id": user_id, "status": content, "event": "status_updated" } ) except RetryAfter as retry_error: rate_limit_until = current_time_ms + (retry_error.retry_after * 1000) except Exception as e: logger.debug( "Status edit failed", extra={"user_id": user_id, "error": str(e)} ) continue
# Handle token frames (AC #3: transition from status to response) if chunk_type == "token" and content: if is_first_token: # First token - transition from status to response response_buffer.append(content) current_text = "".join(response_buffer)
# Edit status message with first token (seamless transition) try: html_text = markdown_to_telegram_html(current_text) await context.bot.edit_message_text( chat_id=chat_id, message_id=status_message_id, text=html_text, parse_mode=ParseMode.HTML ) sent_messages.append(status_message_id) # Track for later edits last_update_time = time.time() * 1000 is_first_token = False
# Cancel typing indicator if typing_task: typing_task.cancel()
logger.info( "Transitioned to response streaming", extra={ "user_id": user_id, "event": "status_to_response_transition" } ) except Exception as e: logger.error( "Failed to transition status to response", extra={"user_id": user_id, "error": str(e)} ) else: # Continue accumulating response (existing logic) response_buffer.append(content) # ... rest of existing token handling logic
except Exception as e: logger.error( "Stream processing failed", extra={"user_id": user_id, "error": str(e)}, exc_info=True ) raise

modification.description: Update stream_response() to yield structured frames instead of just text content
modification.code-pattern:
async def stream_response( self, conversation_id: str, user_id: int ) -> AsyncGenerator[dict, None]: # Changed from str to dict """ Stream LLM response from backend using Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Yields: Structured frames as dicts: {"type": "status|token|done|error", "content": "...", ...} """ # ... existing setup code ...
async with self.session.get(endpoint) as response: response.raise_for_status()
chunk_count = 0 first_token_received = False async for line in response.content: decoded_line = line.decode("utf-8").strip()
if not decoded_line or decoded_line.startswith(":"): continue
if decoded_line.startswith("data: "): data = decoded_line[6:]
if data == "[DONE]": logger.info("Response stream completed", ...) break
try: chunk_data = json.loads(data) chunk_type = chunk_data.get("type")
# Yield all frame types (status, token, done, error) if chunk_type == "status": # NEW: Yield status frames yield chunk_data elif chunk_type == "token": content = chunk_data.get("content", "") if content: chunk_count += 1 if not first_token_received: first_token_received = True yield chunk_data # Yield full frame, not just content elif chunk_type == "done": yield chunk_data break elif chunk_type == "error": yield chunk_data raise Exception(f"Backend error: {chunk_data.get('message')}")
except json.JSONDecodeError as e: logger.warning(f"Failed to parse stream chunk: {data[:100]}", ...) continue

implementation-notes.note: Ensure backward compatibility: If backend doesn't send status frames (Story 11.2 incomplete), bot should still work with token-only frames
The transition from status to response (AC #3) must be seamless: use edit_message_text() to replace status content with first token, avoiding any flicker or duplicate messages
Pending message handling (AC #4) should accumulate multiple messages as newline-separated text, allowing LLM to see natural chat history flow
Consider removing or reducing typing indicator since status message provides more informative feedback. Could keep typing for initial message receipt before status starts updating.
For testing: Mock SSE stream with status frames in integration tests to verify edit behavior
